The '''Iron Shovel''' is the first [[Shovels|shovel]] players can purchase in the game.

== Overview ==
A tough iron shovel.

The '''Iron Shovel''' is the first shovel you can purchase in the game. It has similar stats to the previous shovel with low {{Stat|Dig Strength}}, slow {{Stat|Dig Speed}}, and minimal {{Stat|Toughness}}, an introduction to quests in the game.

== Stats ==
* {{Stat|Dig Strength}}: '''2'''
* {{Stat|Dig Speed}}: '''0.8'''
* {{Stat|Toughness}}: '''1'''

== Obtainment ==
* The shovel is located next to the [[Shopkeepers|Shopkeeper]] in [[Rubble_Creek|Rubble Creek Sands]].
